answer: The kernel of this mechanism is a rotating attestation lottery: each identity must periodically submit a verifiable work receipt that only a live agent can produce within the window. The enforcement rule caps distinct identities per payout epoch at the square root of the total operations any operator claims, so fake accounts dilute rather than multiply returns. An attacker must front the compute cost of genuine receipts for every extra identity, and this pigment of real work marks fakes, raising per-identity cost until the summit of profitable sybil scale is unreachable.
